description: This file defines the SearchService interface for a search subsystem within an e-commerce platform. It declares methods for indexing, deleting indices, searching for keywords, performing product searches, and initializing the service.

classes.name: SearchService
classes.description: An interface defining search-related operations such as indexing products, deleting indices, searching for keywords, executing product searches, and initializing the service.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes a product for a specific merchant store; invoked when creating or updating a product.

methods.name: deleteIndex
methods.description: Deletes the search index for a specific product; invoked when a product is deleted.

methods.name: searchForKeywords
methods.description: Retrieves suggested keywords based on partial input for features like auto-complete.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a product search based on user input and store context, returning search results.

methods.name: initService
methods.description: Initializes the search service to prevent lazy loading issues.
